# kaleido_platform_pms_policy_identity_list_binding (Resource)

Manages an identity list binding on a Policy Manager policy. The binding resolves an attester label declared in the policy definition to a specific version of an identity list, determining who is allowed to attest to the evidence.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolves the "treasuryOperations" attester label declared in the policy definition
# to a specific version of an identity list. Re-pointing at a newer version is an
# in-place update; changing the label replaces the binding.
resource "kaleido_platform_pms_policy_identity_list_binding" "treasury_ops" {
  environment              = kaleido_platform_environment.env_0.id
  service                  = kaleido_platform_service.pms_0.id
  policy                   = kaleido_platform_pms_policy.dual_approval.id
  attester_label           = "treasuryOperations"
  identity_list_version_id = kaleido_platform_pms_identity_list.treasury_ops.applied_version_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attester_label` (String) The attester label declared in a policy evidence attestation slot (e.g. 'treasuryOperations'). Immutable after create.
- `environment` (String) Environment ID
- `identity_list_version_id` (String) ID of the identity list version whose members may attest under this label. This is a version ID, not a version name - use the applied_version_id attribute of a kaleido_platform_pms_identity_list.
- `policy` (String) Name or ID of the policy this binding belongs to
- `service` (String) Policy Manager service ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The binding ID assigned by the server
